about:
Aegis keeps your Telegram groups and channels safe and lively — free.

🛡 Anti-spam, anti-raid, captcha, flood and link guards, 42 locks
⚙️ Setup wizard, notes, filters, welcome messages, warnings and logs
📢 Channels: scheduled posts, join requests, admins vote on direct messages
📊 Statistics, points, contests and polls
🎲 100 fun features: games, fortune telling, fonts

Add Aegis to your group as an admin, then send /config.
about_short: Group and channel manager: anti-spam, captcha, locks, notes, stats, games — free, in 5 languages.
